senses.gloss: m. (cmp. חַזְרָר) medlar (Mespilus Azarolus, v. Löw Pfl., p. 288, a. Sm. Ant. s. v. Mespile), being considered homogeneous to quincy. [In Mish. a. Babyl. dialect (עוּזְרָד) עוּזְרָר, but different from הַזְרָר.] Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ תפוח ע״ג חיזרד; (Tosef. ib. I, 3 אוּזְרָד).—Pl. חוּזְרָרִין.
